_comment: Ten tasks of one type, claim_check, for the sub-agent corpus (run with --subagents).
Same sandbox as tasks.json. Every task asks the team to check one claim about
sales.csv and to end with VERDICT: TRUE or VERDICT: FALSE, so the outcome can be
scored by a program. 'answer' is the correct verdict; check_claims.py recomputes
it from sales.csv and refuses to score if the two disagree. The agents never see it.
Six claims are true and four false, so a team that always agrees is caught.

tasks.claim: East sold fewer units in Q2 than in Q1.
North's revenue grew from Q1 to Q2.
South had the highest revenue of any region in Q2.
East sold more units in Q1 than any other region.
Total Q1 revenue across all regions exceeds 3,000.
South's units grew by more than 60% from Q1 to Q2.
North raised its price in Q2.
East's revenue was higher in Q2 than in Q1.
The average price over all six rows of sales.csv is above 10.5.
Total units sold in Q2 exceed total units sold in Q1 by more than 70.

prompt_template: Check this claim against sales.csv in the working directory: "{claim}" Compute the numbers from the data, have the result independently verified, and end your answer with one line that reads VERDICT: TRUE or VERDICT: FALSE.
